Commercial applications such as hospitality, retail signage, and corporate AV are in scope only when the product sold is a complete television set, not a dedicated commercial display or projector.

setup.scope: This market covers the value of finished television sets (TVs) sold as complete consumer or commercial display products, including all display technologies (LCD, LED, OLED, QLED), screen sizes, and smart/traditional configurations, whether sold to residential or commercial end users. It excludes separately valued upstream components and inputs such as display panels, semiconductors, and tuners, as well as separately valued content, streaming, and advertising services (e.g., IPTV subscriptions, Google TV app store revenue) that are not part of the TV hardware transaction. It also excludes adjacent product categories such as computer monitors, digital signage, and projectors, which are distinct markets even where they share display technology. Panel and component production volumes may be used as intermediate evidence to derive TV unit demand, but are never priced or valued as part of this market.
